objective: Define the scoped run boundary that may prove reviewed native-path bridge metadata can invoke the existing sidecar launcher and reach coverage-output compare, without executing that run in this gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted bridge fixture proves only metadata readiness. A later run may still fail before launcher invocation, inside a sidecar stage, or during coverage-output compare, so sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, and compare_failure must remain distinct.
reason: the previous review accepted define_sidecar_launcher_bridge_fixture only as metadata
the bridge fixture marks src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py as reference_only_not_invoked_by_fixture
the next useful step is defining exactly when a later run may invoke the existing launcher
coverage_output_equivalence remains the only scoped correctness policy

artifacts: raw state dumps used by compare

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before the expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser or bridge metadata exists but target/template/shape/source context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed bridge or stage authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure: bridge metadata exists, but the future run does not invoke the sidecar launcher from the native path
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the sidecar launcher is invoked, but a scoped build/run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_run_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the future run boundary is narrow enough for a first sidecar-launcher invocation attempt
whether the boundary correctly distinguishes bridge failure, sidecar stage failure, and compare failure
whether generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical
whether the boundary keeps timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput out of scope

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
